free_tier.stated: Traffic-based, not capacity-based: '每位免费用户每月最多可上传1GB的文件，可下载3GB的文件'. Space grows with what you upload and is bounded by the traffic allowance, so effective free storage ≈ 1 GB/month of net new data.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: no retention statement was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that retention is unlimited
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Metered in the same currency: 3 GB/month of downloads for free users. No per-GB pricing on the free tier — it just stops syncing.

tooling: Official WebDAV — '国内少数官方支持 WebDAV 的同步盘', app-password generation documented at help.jianguoyun.com/?p=2803. Works with rclone's `webdav` backend directly, no reverse engineering.
chaining: 1 GB/month upload per account is not a capacity play at all. Its value is the *only* approved WebDAV endpoint in the Chinese consumer market — useful as a control plane, not as bytes.
limits_note: request-rate (monthly byte-rate): 1 GB up / 3 GB down per month, hard stop when exhausted ('当流量耗尽后将无法继续同步'). No per-file cap number read.
reliability_note: Very stable, ten-year-old service; the constraint is deliberate and enforced.
confidence_note: mechanically converted from the seed corpus; no page was read for this record in the storage-dossier pass. One page read moves it to documented.
